audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 win condition on this page is built on a mechanic Yone does not have: "Fate Sealed's dash-knockup ... carries him airborne through his own R Purgatory timing - the totem cannot execute what your ult is juggling", repeated in spikes[1].text, mid and whys[4].
audit.why: Riot's R text: "Yone blinks behind the last champion in a line with a slash so powerful it pulls all enemies hit towards him." It is a PULL, not a knockup — nobody goes airborne, so the airborne-denies-execute claim is fabricated twice over. The packet also flagged this line under suspectNames.
audit.corrected: Rewrote all three fields around what Fate Sealed does — blink behind, drag him back into your Q3 — and dropped the airborne claim entirely.
sources: packet suspectNames (snippet: "Fate Sealed's dash-knockup catches his W burst window")

audit.whatIsWrong: Only Ashen Pursuit's 10s appeared on the page; Soul Ignition, the ability the whole trading section revolves around, had no cooldown anywhere.
audit.why: Soul Ignition is 18/17/16/15/14s — the longest cooldown in his kit and the one that gates his commit. Knowing it is 18s at rank 1 is what makes 'punish the window' actionable.
audit.corrected: Put 18s into breakdown.cooldowns, spikes[1].text and mid.

audit.why: All seven rows read Yone on both layers and match the packet chart, which is also all Yone; the whys are consistent with the sides.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t says "Anti-heal is optional — his sustain is self-refund, not lifesteal", and calls his damage AP.
audit.why: Riot's W text: "At the end of the duration, Locke will heal back a portion of the damage he takes during the effect." That is healing, and Grievous Wounds applies to it — the timing that matters is having it on him BEFORE the duration ends. The kit also flags true damage on W, which no amount of MR answers.
audit.corrected: Rewrote the itemization line: anti-heal applied before the W expires, and true damage called out as the hole in a pure-resistance build.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warned that Ashen Pursuit is an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: It teleports and then dashes to attack — the damage arrives on an attack wind-up, so watching for the blink alone is watching for the wrong thing.

edits.before: Fate Sealed is the totem killer: catch him during his W commit and the knockup carries him through his own R Purgatory window - he cannot execute while airborne.
edits.after: Fate Sealed is a pull, not a knockup — it blinks behind him and drags him to you, so yank him out of a Soul Ignition commit and finish inside its 18s.

edits.before: Level 6 Fate Sealed catches his W window and nullifies his R totem.
edits.after: Level 6 Fate Sealed pulls him out of his W window and off his zone.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 his grey-health commit pattern keeps losing to E's safety valve, and at 6 your R writes the ending: Fate Sealed's dash-knockup catches his W burst window and carries him airborne through his own R Purgatory timing - the totem cannot execute what your ult is juggling. All-in on your schedule.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 his grey-health commit keeps losing to Soul Unbound's safety valve, and at 6 your R writes the ending: Fate Sealed blinks behind him and PULLS him out of his Soul Ignition window, straight into your Q3 - his commit is 18s and your answer outlasts it. All-in on your schedule.

edits.before: E's return-dash makes his execute unlandable - trade in spirit form, snap back before the totem drops, and R-engage on your timing only.
edits.after: Soul Unbound snaps you back to the body you left - park that body outside his zone before you trade, and R-engage on your timing only.

edits.before: A totem placed on your return-dash landing spot
edits.after: A totem dropped on the body you snap back to

edits.before: Early HP and MR blunt the nail chip (his damage is AP). A stopwatch/Zhonya’s-class answer beats Purgatory outright: untargetable at the floor = execute denied. Anti-heal is optional — his sustain is self-refund, not lifesteal.
edits.after: Early HP and MR blunt the nail chip, but Soul Ignition carries true damage no resistance touches. Grievous Wounds is not optional: his W heals back part of the self-damage at the END of its duration, so land anti-heal before it expires.

edits.before: - Locke Ritual Nails (Marks): matchup-defining — The nail marks are his whole engine — without 2-3 stacks on you his blink-in barely dents; sidestep the recasts and punish the ten seconds of nothing. Track it before every step-up. - Locke E (Ashen Pursuit): his ONLY mobility, resets on takedowns — the post-E window is the lane. - Locke R (Purgatory): never fight at sliver HP inside the zone.
edits.after: - Locke Ritual Nails (Marks): matchup-defining — The nail marks are his whole engine — without 2-3 stacks on you his blink-in barely dents; sidestep the recasts and punish the ten seconds of nothing. Track it before every step-up. - Locke E (Ashen Pursuit): 10s flat, his ONLY mobility, and an auto reset — the post-E window is the lane. - Locke W (Soul Ignition): 18s at rank 1, and it refunds health at the end. - Locke R: never fight at sliver HP inside the zone.

edits.before: Post-6: the totem rewrites fight math — win exchanges early, disengage above the floor, and punish the ten seconds after every spent E.
edits.after: Post-6: end fights above his floor, punish the 10s after every spent Ashen Pursuit, and land Grievous Wounds before Soul Ignition refunds him.

edits.before: Levels 1-3: he pays for every CS at 125 range — tax him, but step off the Q recast lines; the mark stacks are the only currency he trades in.
edits.after: Levels 1-3: tax him at every CS, but step off the Q recast lines. Ashen Pursuit is an auto reset — the burst opens on the attack, not on the blink.

notes: The level-6 plan on this page was fabricated: Fate Sealed is a pull, so 'carries him airborne through his own Purgatory' described a mechanic Yone does not have, and 'he cannot execute while airborne' is unverifiable on top of that. Fixed in three fields. NOT changed, because I could not verify them: (1) the '125 range' claim about Locke, repeated in four fields — his kit lists no attack range; (2) the ability names 'Ritual Nails' and 'Purgatory' — the brief supplies no name for his Q or R (the kit text mentions 'Soul Nails' as the thrown objects), and the packet's enemyAbilities is null; (3) the kit's derived grounding flag on his R, which would shut off your Q3 dash, Soul Unbound and Fate Sealed inside the zone — Riot's own text does not mention grounding, so I did not put it on the page. If that flag is real it is the single most important line in this matchup and should be written in.
